exposure: Type of immune-mediated disease (rheumatic vs. other)
cohort: Finnish citizens born between 1964 and 1984 who were diagnosed with any of the 19 immune-mediated diseases before age 30 (women) or 35 (men), matched with 20 controls
finding: Several rheumatic diseases, particularly SLE, JIA, and seropositive RA, were associated with higher rates of childlessness and fewer children, while many immune-mediated diseases, including rheumatic diseases, were associated with increased risks of adverse maternal and perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Non-elective cesarean sections were more common in women with several immune-mediated diseases, including rheumatic diseases.
